name: Ricardo Sepúlveda
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began later in life. Before finding his passion, he worked as a general metalworker in Santiago, focusing on practical, durable solutions. He transitioned to motorsport after volunteering at a local rally team, discovering a knack for adapting and repairing under pressure. He views fabrication as an art, always seeking ways to improve upon existing designs.

Though still relatively new to the high-stakes world of professional racing, Ricardo possesses an inherent understanding of mechanics and material science. He's eager to learn from experienced engineers and fabricators, driven by a desire to push the boundaries of what's possible in vehicle construction. He is determined to become an expert and contribute to a race-winning team, despite his late start.

Ricardo's practical experience has instilled in him a deep appreciation for reliability and robustness. He prioritizes functionality over aesthetics, believing that a well-built car is inherently beautiful. He constantly analyzes the strengths and weaknesses of various construction techniques, demonstrating an ambition to constantly learn and improve.

physical.description: Ricardo is of medium build, with calloused hands that show years of working with metal.

quirks: Always sharpens his welding rods before starting a job.
Carries a small notebook filled with sketches of potential improvements to existing designs.
Has a habit of humming traditional Chilean folk songs while working.
